title: Pocket FFM provider policy
summary: Cole separated builder billing from application runtime billing and approved the application provider policy through the October 5 cutover decision.
evidence: Claude Code and Codex builder sessions remain at zero Anthropic API billing.
Through October 5, Pocket FFM staging and production use the existing application Anthropic key for answers with the existing OpenAI path as failover.
Cole accepts application testing cost under this policy.
Dan and Mary decide the permanent provider account and credential at the October 5 cutover.
T-042 is GO after the embed.js seam is assigned in OWNERSHIP.md.
The T-043 load-test cap is $50, with p95 at or below 8 seconds, error rate under 1 percent, and zero SQLite busy errors at 1,000 concurrent sessions.
limitations: This approval does not permit builder sessions to use Anthropic API billing and does not itself authorize production cutover or a provider credential swap.
